## Constraints

### Must

- Preserve the dark editorial identity, lime accent, typography, section order, and restrained interaction language.
- Respect reduced motion and visible keyboard focus.

### Avoid

- Neon glow effects, generic gradients, glassmorphism, oversized rounded cards, decorative 3D, and generic AI imagery.

## Decisions

- Use reusable opacity-plus-translation viewport reveals with subtle stagger and 2–4px hover movement.
- Present skills as a technical inventory matrix and workflows as editorial grids with controlled lime markers.
- Use the background-keyed alpha WebM as a compact floating chat launcher with no mask, halo, permanent label, or pill surface.
